title: A Trip to the Shop
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Monday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, bread, eggs and apples. She needs these things for breakfast.

In the shop, Anna finds the milk first. Then she takes bread and eggs. She does not buy the apples because she has apples at home. She pays at the counter and goes home.

questions.text: What is on Anna's shopping list?
What does Anna NOT buy in the shop?
Why does Anna not buy apples?
options: She already has apples at home

questions.text: What is most likely true about Anna's breakfast?
options: She will eat food from her list
She will not eat at home
She will eat in the shop

vocabulary.definition: a set of written names or items to remember or buy
a place where you buy things
gives money for something you buy
the first meal of the day, in the morning

paragraph_translations: Anna idzie do sklepu w poniedziałek. Ma listę zakupów w ręku. Lista ma mleko, chleb, jajka i jabłka. Potrzebuje tych rzeczy na śniadanie.
W sklepie Anna najpierw znajduje mleko. Potem bierze chleb i jajka. Nie kupuje jabłek, bo ma jabłka w domu. Płaci przy ladzie i idzie do domu.
